issues.finding: The unbounded definition uses an undeclared hi, and the height-preserving definition uses n simultaneously as premise count and proof-height bound.
issues.proposed_resolution: Use unbounded provability for ordinary inversion and a separate height bound h while retaining n as the premise count.

issues.finding: The opening proof claim says any G3c rule, although the lemma lists only propositional rules and existential-right/universal-left are not invertible in this sense.
issues.proposed_resolution: Restrict the proof opening to the propositional rules covered by the lemma.

issues.location: inversion and contraction axiom base cases
issues.finding: The base-case descriptions classify all G3c axioms as atomic identity, omitting falsity-left; contraction can also contract falsity itself on the left.
issues.proposed_resolution: Qualify the identity descriptions, include preserved antecedent falsity in inversion and contraction, including contracted falsity, and recall both axiom cases for quantified inversion.

issues.finding: The text after applying induction still displays the undecomposed conjunction, while the following diagrams correctly use its two components.
issues.proposed_resolution: Use A and B separately in both textual induction-result sequents.

issues.finding: The first universal contraction diagram is labelled existential-right despite introducing a universal formula.
issues.proposed_resolution: Use the universal-right label in that diagram.

issues.finding: The witness instance B(t) loses its argument in the induction-result text and subsequent premise diagram.
issues.proposed_resolution: Retain B(t) in both places, matching the original existential premise and the reapplied rule.

issues.finding: The example chooses a constant fresh only for Delta, although the lemma also requires freshness for Gamma and the quantified formula; internal eigenparameters may otherwise conflict with the inserted instance.
issues.proposed_resolution: Preserve the full lemma freshness condition and rename existing eigenparameters within their corresponding subtrees fresh for the chosen constant before induction.
